title: Stepwise Protocol for Efficient PBMC Extraction and Immunostaining in Camel Samples
author: Cinthia Mariel Olexen
materials: Dilute the primary antibodies in blocking/staining buffer at the manufacturer’s recommended concentration and incubate for 20 minutes on ice.
Resuspend the cell pellets with the secondary antibodies in adequate dilution with blocking/staining buffer and incubate 20 min on ice, protected from the light.

steps.title: Blood Collection
steps.instruction: Collect blood from the camel via jugular venipuncture at either the low neck (near thoracic inlet) or high neck (near ramus of mandible).

substeps.instruction: Restrain the camel safely to minimize stress and movement.
Clean the venipuncture site with an alcohol swab and allow to dry.
Using sterile technique, insert the needle into the selected vein.
Draw blood into an EDTA tube (purple cap) for hematology, filling to the indicated volume without overfilling.
Collect blood into a gel separator tube (yellow cap) for plasma chemistry.
Remove the needle and apply pressure to the puncture site until bleeding stops.

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Process the collected blood tubes for plasma and PBMC extraction.

substeps.instruction: Gently invert the EDTA tube 8-10 times to mix anticoagulant; do not shake vigorously.
Store EDTA tubes in an appropriate transport container at 15-20°C until processing.
Leave the gel separator tube upright at room temperature for 30 minutes to clot.
Centrifuge the gel separator tube as soon as possible (e.g., 10 minutes at 1500 x g) to separate plasma.
Transfer plasma to new, identified tubes and store refrigerated or frozen depending on analysis.

steps.title: PBMC Density Gradient Separation
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from whole blood using Ficoll-Paque PLUS in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Label 50-mL conical tubes per specimen and pour whole blood from EDTA tubes into them.
Dilute the blood 1:1 with PBS.
In a new 50-mL conical tube, add Ficoll-Paque PLUS at a ratio of 1 volume Ficoll to 3 volumes of diluted blood.
Slowly and carefully layer the diluted blood through the wall of the tube over the Ficoll so the layers do not mix (blood layer on top).
Centrifuge at 1900 rpm (≈500-600g) for 20 minutes at room temperature, with acceleration and brake set to 0.

steps.title: PBMC Recovery and Washing
steps.instruction: Collect and purify the PBMC layer.

substeps.instruction: Carefully collect the cloudy PBMC layer (located between the top plasma layer and the clear Ficoll layer) using a 5-mL pipet on slow, avoiding the Ficoll layer.
Transfer PBMCs to a new conical tube containing PBS.
Centrifuge at 1800 rpm for 10 minutes with brake set to 9.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL PBS (adjust volume based on pellet size).
Repeat the wash step two more times.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Quantify viable cells and freeze the remaining PBMC population.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in sRPMI.
Transfer 10 µL of resuspended cells into a 1.5 mL vial containing 90 µL of Trypan Blue solution.
Place 10 µL of the mixture into a hemacytometer chamber; count unstained viable cells and calculate total number.
Wash cells again with supplemented RPMI medium and centrifuge at 1800 rpm for 10 minutes; discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in cold freezing media (90% FBS + 10% DMSO).
Transfer cells to a labeled cryovial at a recommended concentration of at least 5 x 10^6 PBMC/vial.
Cap vials tightly, place in a room-temperature Mr. Frosty container, and transfer to -80°C freezer for at least 48 hours before moving to nitrogen.

steps.title: Immunostaining Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare a subset of PBMCs for T and B cell staining.

substeps.instruction: Separate 2 - 5 x 10^6 PBMCs for immunostaining.
Wash the cells with sRPMI at 1800 rpm for 10 minutes and discharge the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µL of 1x PBS and transfer to a 96-well plate.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant by inverting the plate in a single motion.

steps.title: Blocking and Staining
steps.instruction: Perform cell blocking and antibody staining.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL of blocking/staining buffer (0.5% BSA, 0.01% sodium azide (NaN₃), and 1× PBS).
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Wash twice with the same buffer, centrifuging at 300g for 5 minutes each time.
Complete the plate volume up to 200 µL of blocking/staining buffer, centrifuge, and discharge supernatant.
Directly resuspend the cells in FACS buffer.
Filter and transfer samples to FACS tubes for cytometer analysis.
